name: fporcari
description: Repository workflow plugins for pull request and issue triage, review, and execution.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: PR and issue workflow toolkit: triage skills plus the git desk, a local page in the Browser pane that lists the PRs whose next move is yours, ready for pr-loop, with pluggable git hosting providers (GitHub, Forgejo).

plugins.name: dw
plugins.description: Deploy workflow, on-demand skills only: dep-merger builds the release checklist of what develop carries over master and turns the reviewer's ticks into a cherry-pick list; dev-tester builds the acceptance-test page for the people who reported the fixes.
